name: Chablyy AI
author: Chablyy

sections.description:
Chablyy AI is the official WordPress companion for Chablyy. Install it, add your connection key once, and your site gets the same modern chat experience you already use in Chablyy—right on your pages, for every visitor.

Why site owners love it

  • Quick setup — One field under Settings → Chablyy AI; no messy paste-ins or theme edits.
  • Always there for visitors — The chat appears on your public site so people can reach you when it matters.
  • Powered by Chablyy — Replies, workflows, and intelligence stay in your Chablyy workspace; WordPress just brings the widget to your audience.

You need an active Chablyy account and the embed key from your dashboard. The plugin connects your site to Chablyy; it does not replace your Chablyy subscription or dashboard.

Service & terms

Chablyy is a hosted service. By using this plugin with your site you connect to that service and agree to the Chablyy Terms of Service.

Privacy

When someone uses the chat on your site, their messages and related session details are handled by Chablyy so the conversation can run. Read how Chablyy processes data in the Privacy Policy. You should reflect that in your own site privacy and cookie notices where required.

Usage

After you save your key, the chat shows on your live site for visitors (not inside the WordPress admin). No extra setup, blocks, or shortcodes required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to wp-content/plugins/chablyy-ai (or install the zip from your WordPress admin).
  2. Activate Chablyy AI under Plugins.
  3. Open Settings → Chablyy AI.
  4. Paste the Embed Key from your Chablyy dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Chablyy account?

Yes. This plugin is the bridge between WordPress and Chablyy—you configure the key from your Chablyy account.

Where do I find my embed key?

In your Chablyy dashboard, in the widget or site setup area where WordPress / embed instructions are shown.

The chat is not showing. What should I check?

Make sure the embed key is saved, you are viewing the public front of your site (not wp-admin), and that your Chablyy project allows your site’s domain if you use domain restrictions there.
